Congratulations to @yudhistira_gpp, our Novus Jiva Giveaway Winner! 🎉

Your story reminded us that sometimes, the getaway we dream of isn’t about going somewhere far or having an elaborate plan. It’s simply about having a little time to pause, breathe, watch the sunset, and enjoy a moment together with the people we love.

We hope your stay at Novus Jiva becomes the little escape you’ve been wishing for, and a beautiful memory to share with your family. 😊🩵

And to our Honorable Mentions, thank you for taking the time to share your stories with us. We loved reading each one of them, and we hope our special gift brings a little joy your way. 🩵

To our winner and Honorable Mentions, please send us a DM at @novusjivaanyer with your contact details so our team can get in touch with you regarding your prize and special gift.

Thank you to everyone who joined our giveaway and shared a little piece of your story with us!✨

Until your next escape,
see you at Novus Jiva Anyer. 🩵

🐢💙 Every life deserves a second chance.

Not every turtle makes it back to the ocean safely. Some arrive injured, tired, and in need of care.

At Mutiara Carita Cottages, we do our part to care for injured sea turtles, helping them recover before they can return to the sea where they belong. 🌊

Because protecting the ocean also means protecting the lives within it.

Heal. Recover. Return to the ocean. 🐢🌊

#MutiaraCaritaCottages #SeaTurtleConservation #SaveTheTurtles #TurtleRescue #CaritaBeach
